request: GitHub Issue #463. Goal: preserve bounded per-child execution diagnostics for nested final-regression commands and classify failures only from concrete preserved evidence. Scope: tests/run.js, src/flow/lib/run-final-regression.js, and final-regression execution/classification tests; capture command identity, start/spawn state, exit code, signal, spawn error, timeout, stdout/stderr, truncation metadata, and durable raw-log references; distinguish exit, signal, timeout, spawn error, assertion output, and silent non-zero exit; prove zero extra test-process invocations. Out of Scope: re-fixing Issue #451 product code, changing regression execution points/counts or retry behavior, converting failures to PASS/skipped, and reducing assertions.
